headline: Host-linked metagenomics infers microbial function within host-associated communities
label: Host Microbiome Functional Genomics
summary: Host-depleted sampling and metabolic modeling now pair individual microbial taxa and host genes with functional inference in tissue-associated communities.
synthesis: The dominant thread is functional inference from host-associated microbial communities. A colorectal cancer preprint applies metabolic models to tumor microbiomes, reporting faster Fusobacterium growth in tumor settings and linking microbial metabolism to host transcriptomes. The cattle study introduces Dilute-MetaSeq, which reduces host DNA interference 52.4-fold, and uses it to build the MGA-GE atlas of 1,907 prokaryotic and 5,603 viral genomes from the gut epithelium. What is new relative to taxonomic census is the pairing of host-depleted or host-linked sampling with functional inference at the level of individual taxa and host genes. The groundwater virome and PlasticEnz tool address functional questions in environmental metagenomes without a host-linked design, so they sit adjacent to this thread rather than within it.
